title: Instrument Communication Driver Library — Overview and definition
t: Instrument Communication Driver Library — Overview and definition
description: Talks SCPI, VISA, and IVI to lab instruments from any programming language.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Talks SCPI, VISA, and IVI to lab instruments from any programming language. An instrument communication driver library wraps VISA, USBTMC, LXI, and GPIB transports with SCPI command builders, IVI-COM/IVI-C drivers, and auto-discovery of connected instruments. Real implementations include PyVISA, NI-VISA/IVI drivers, and Rigol/Siglent vendor libraries. It handles timeouts, retries, binary block transfers, and calibration-certificate queries.
capabilities: VISA resource discovery across USB, LAN, and GPIB
SCPI command builders with query/set and binary block support
IVI driver interchangeability between vendors
Automatic timeout, retry, and error-queue handling
Calibration date and self-test queries for traceability
